rules.cite: Berkeley Rent Ordinance (Measure BB), Annual General Adjustment
rules.coverage_text: Fully covered rental units under the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.
rules.requirement: The Annual General Adjustment for fully covered units cannot exceed 5% in any year, even if the CPI formula produces a higher figure. Banked AGAs may still be used to reach the rent ceiling.
rules.title: AGA capped at 5%

rules.cite: Berkeley Rent Ordinance (Measure BB), Just Cause
rules.coverage_text: Fully or partially covered units under the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.

key_values.name: minimum_debt
key_values.text: one month of the Fair Market Rent

rules.quote: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.
rules.requirement: A landlord may evict for nonpayment only if the rental debt is at least one month of HUD Fair Market Rent for a unit of equivalent size.
rules.title: Nonpayment eviction minimum debt
